verdict.rationale: Productboard provides an MCP server and API explicitly designed to let coding agents/developers access approved product specifications to 'initiate the product delivery process,' plus integration hooks and webhooks for syncing into delivery tools. However, there's no evidence of a native dev-tool (e.g., Jira/GitHub) sync or hands-on confirmation of this workflow's reliability, so it relies on vendor claims and integration building rather than a proven out-of-box handoff.
